title: Elements UI Class Abstraction
description: Framework-free @elements/ui-shell (Workbench, App, Mode, Controller, CommandBus); React WorkbenchView + ReactUI.mount; migrate plays + semio algorithm shell; remove AppConfig/PureAppDefinition.
